text: Hello and welcome to this live commentary for the Premier League fixture between Manchester City and Newcastle United from Etihad Stadium.
We are early into the Premier League season but both of these two sides will be keen to build on their respective positive starts to the season.
Pep Guardiola's side breezed past the returning Burnley last Friday before adding a Super Cup to their ever-growing trophy cabinet in midweek.
Newcastle face a tough task away to the league champions but will be buoyed by their comprehensive 5-1 thumping of Aston Villa on the opening weekend.
Guardiola makes two changes from his side's midweek Super Cup victory against Sevilla.
Alvarez returns to the starting XI in place of Palmer while Dias starts instead of Ake in defence.
Eddie Howe, meanwhile, names an unchanged side after Newcastle's 5-1 win against Aston Villa last weekend.
City have lost just one of their last 31 Premier League games against Newcastle (W25 D5), going down 2-1 at St.
James' Park in January 2019.
The players are out on the pitch now and the game is moments away!
City get this first half under way.
There's an early stoppage as Schar receives treatment following a nasty fall after a collision with Haaland.
The Swiss centre-back is back on his feet and looks like he will continue.
A solid start in possession from City so far as they look to control the early exchanges.
Trippier tries to get forward for the first time this game but he's caught in an offside position as he attempts to cross from the byline.
Grealish cuts inside from the left but his shot is blocked well by a diving Trippier.
City have had 85 per cent possession in the opening ten minutes of this game.
An uncharacteristic miscontrol from Haaland as he allows the ball to drift out for a goal-kick having received it on the left side of the penalty area.
Walker has plenty of space out on the right as he cuts the ball back to Akanji.
The centre-back tries his luck from range but it flies well over the bar.
The first notable attack of the game for Newcastle as Gordon drives down the left.
He can't find a man in a black and white shirt as Akanji smashes it clear.
Newcastle are growing into the game now but a loose pass from Guimaraes gifts City back possession on the edge of their box.
Almiron lets the ball run and Joelinton picks it up on the edge of the box.
He's stretching slightly as he takes a shot but it's smothered well by the City defence and cleared away.
The first yellow card of the game as Gordon's studs catch the calf of Dias.
City play long towards Haaland but Schar and Botman work together well to crowd out the striker as the ball runs through to Pope.
Alvarez finds a pocket of space on the left side of the box, but Botman is well-positioned and clears the Argentine's cross before it can reach Haaland.
Kovacic tries his luck from the edge of the box as the loose ball bounces into the path of the Croatian midfielder.
He catches it cleanly but it's blocked by the Newcastle defence.
GOOOOAAAALLL!!! CITY AHEAD! 1-0! The deadlock is broken and Alvarez has the opener for City.
Foden has time and space on the right to pick out Alvarez on the edge of the box.
The Argentine shifts it onto his right foot before smashing it into the far corner with Pope only able to get a fingertip on it.

events.action: smashing it into the far corner

text: Foden did well to find Alvarez with the disguised cutback, with the Argentine finishing in superb fashion.
Another Newcastle yellow card as Tonali brings down Foden as he bears down on the penalty area.
Kovacic has another chance on the edge of the box but, once again, his effort is smothered and blocked by the Newcastle defence.
There's a brief VAR check for a Kovacic handball but no penalty is given.
Grealish picks up the ball on the left edge of the box but Trippier is tight to him once again as the right-black blocks his latest effort.
With half-time fast approaching, Newcastle are still yet to register a shot on target.
WIDE! City are inches away from their second of the game.
Ederson goes long to Grealish, who finds Foden.
He, in turn, feeds Haaland, whose first-time effort from inside the area just drifts wide of the left post.
The first corner of the game comes for City as Trippier turns behind Foden's cross.
Grealish delivers but Guimaraes can clear after Dias's header can't find another City player inside the box.
There will be three minutes of added time to end this first half.
A late chance for Newcastle as Trippier's cross finds Gordon inside the box.
The winger looks caught in two minds as he opts to bring down the ball rather than strike it first time.
In the end, the touch is poor and it allows the City defence to clear.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 1-0 NEWCASTLE UNITED
Julian Alvarez's goal is the difference at the break as City lead Newcastle 1-0 at Etihad Stadium.
City saw plenty of the ball in the early stages but failed to create any clear-cut chances until their opening goal after 30 minutes.
Having been found by Foden, Alvarez unleashed a vicious strike across goal from the right side of the box, the effort flying past Pope and into the top corner.
Haaland came close to doubling his side's lead before the break but the Norwegian saw his left-footed effort drift wide of the post.
It's been a typical City performance so far with 60 per cent possession and nine shots on goal.
They perhaps haven't been at their clinical best in and around the penalty area but they have their lead and a firm grip on this game.

Newcastle have looked promising, at times, going forward but Eddie Howe's side will need to offer far more consistent attacking threat after the break if they are to find a way back into this encounter.
Newcastle get this second half under way.
An early yellow card in the second half for City as Alvarez brings down Tonali in the middle of the park.
Gordon has the first half chance of the second half for Newcastle but his effort from the left side of the penalty area deflects off Joelinton and goes out for a City throw-in.
Gordon again with a chance as Joelinton finds him in the box.
He tries to spin past Walker and gain half a yard for the shot but, in the end, it's sliced over the bar.
City have a free-kick just inside the Newcastle half but it's wasted and flies straight out for a goal-kick.
Joelinton is the latest to receive a booking after he takes out Foden with a late challenge.
Newcastle make the first changes of the game as Gordon makes way for Barnes.
Joelinton also comes off having potentially suffered a slight injury.
Longstaff replaces him in the middle of the park.
Barnes has only been on the pitch for a matter of moments but the Englishman is already in the book as he pulls back Walker.
It's fantastic defending from Schar as he times a challenge to perfection to not only disposes Haaland inside the penalty area but also win a goal-kick for his side.
Superb from the Swiss centre-back.
Newcastle have a free-kick in a central position inside the City half but it's wasted as Ederson comes off his line to claim the ball with ease.
WIDE! Another chance for Haaland but it drifts wide again.
Foden is relishing the freedom from playing centrally and he slides through the City forward once again.
Haaland creates the room for the left-footed strike but the ball just drifts past the left post in a similar fashion to his chance late in the first half.
Haaland with another chance again straight away but he's forced wide and Pope saves well with his legs.
Guimaraes has a good chance as the ball finds him on the edge of the box.
It's a poor effort from the Brazilian, though, as he scuffs his effort into the ground with the strike trickling harmlessly wide of the post.
Another double change for Newcastle as Isak is replaced by Wilson.
Tonali also comes off with Anderson coming on in his place.
Barnes with his first chance since coming off the bench but his right-footed curling effort is saved comfortably down low by Ederson.
A yellow this time for Guimaraes as he accidentally collides with Foden.
For all of Newcastle's increased intensity in the second half, they have still only registered one shot on target so far this game, that being Barnes's effort from outside the box moments ago.
Trippier brings down Grealish and City have a free-kick out on the left.
Foden delivers but the delivery is cleared away by the Newcastle defence.
Barnes's cross from the left runs all the way through to Almiron.
He strikes it cleanly but it's blocked by the City defence on the edge of the box.
City have now scored in each of their last 30 Premier League games against Newcastle, a record for one side against another in the competition.
With six minutes of normal time remaining, City appear comfortable with this one-goal lead.
Newcastle continue to toil away but to no avail.
A final roll of the dice for Newcastle as Almiron makes way for Livramento who comes on for his Magpies debut.
A chance for Foden to put the game to bed but his strike is blocked by the retreating Burn.
WIDE! Another chance in quick succession as Haaland embarks on a marauding run forward and slips in Foden but the Englishman can only drag his effort wide on the angle.
There will be five minutes of added time to end this second half.
A late foul for City as Kovacic is brought down by Guimaraes just inside the Newcastle half.
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 1-0 NEWCASTLE UNITED
Julian Alvarez's first-half goal was the difference as City continued their perfect start to the Premier League with a 1-0 home win against Newcastle.
It was Pep Guardiola's men who started the better side and they got their just reward after half an hour when Alvarez opened the scoring with a superb strike into the top corner.
Haaland nearly doubled City's lead before the half-time interval and had another good chance midway through the second half but last season's top goalscorer fired wide on both occasions.
In the end, Newcastle struggled to force their way back into the game, with City expertly seeing out the clash and extending the Magpies' unwanted poor record at Etihad Stadium.
City travel to face newly promoted Sheffield United next Sunday while Newcastle host Jurgen Klopp's Liverpool.
That's all for today - thanks for tuning in!
